title: Hong Kong privacy commissioner urges organisations to strengthen data security as cyberattack risk rises
date_note: Wen Wei Po, published 24 Nov 2026, refers to the statement as today (24th).
org: Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (Hong Kong)
geo_basis: regulator based in Hong Kong, as the source states
summary: Wen Wei Po reports that Hong Kong's Privacy Commissioner's office says cyberattack risks are rising worldwide and data breach reports in Hong Kong have increased. It urges all organisations to assess risks, review their systems and act early. It also warns the public about precision fraud, where scammers use leaked data to impersonate staff or customer service.
plain: Hong Kong's privacy regulator urges organisations to tighten data security and warns of scams that use leaked data.
exec: Hong Kong's privacy regulator says breach reports have increased and asks organisations to review their security.
action: The Privacy Commissioner's office advises organisations to assess risks, review their systems and act early against malicious attacks.

sources.name: Wen Wei Po: 環球網絡攻擊風險加劇 私隱專員公署呼籲機構加強資料保安措施

validation.note: One publisher (Wen Wei Po) relaying the commissioner's statement; the PCPD's own page was not read.
